llm.evidence: run on a LTQ Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
By combining Stable Isotope Labeling by Amino acids in Cell culture (SILAC) and phosphoproteomic analysis
Digestion was performed with Lys-C (Wako 125-05061) (1% w:w enzyme:substrate) for 3 hours at 37°C
3 mg Titansphere TiO2 beads (10 µm; GL-Sciences 5020 75010) were added per 500 µg peptides for 15 min shaking incubation at room temperature.
The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode.
proteins were reduced in 20 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), 40 mM ABC for 45 min
